q1_what_did_you_play: I played Rapid Fire at Nibbit for its shown 0 cost, consuming all 3 Sparks, then Duck and Cover for 1 energy, then Kaboom! at Nibbit for its printed 1 cost. This dealt 16 damage from Rapid Fire and 7 damage from Kaboom!, for 23 total, and gained 5 Block.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Slow Burn followed by Kaboom!, which would have spent the 3 Sparks, cost 2 energy total, gained 5 Block, and added Slow Burn's Burst gain, but it would have dealt only 7 damage instead of 23.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up the Burst gain from Slow Burn and any future value from building Burst. It also gave up the lower-damage, Burst-building alternative, but it did not give up damage or Block compared with the best affordable damage line.
q4_different_intent: No. The main alternative, Slow Burn plus Kaboom!, has the same 5 Block, so a different intent would not change the core tradeoff between known 23 damage and Burst gain. If the enemy attacks, the Block is useful; if it does not, the Block is not harmful, and no other affordable line increases damage.
